name: What should I do if my door lock is jammed or won't open?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if my door lock is jammed or won't open?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your door lock is jammed or won't open, avoid forcing it, as this can cause further damage to the lock or the door. First, try lubricating the keyway with a graphite-based lubricant, not oil, as oil can attract dirt. Wiggle the key gently while trying to turn it. If it still doesn't work, contact a professional door lock repair service. They have the tools and expertise to diagnose the problem safely and repair or open the lock without causing additional damage to your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: If your door lock is jammed, don't force it. Try lubricating with graphite. If it persists, call a professional repair service to avoid further damage.
